Subject: Post-signature deployment plan & proposed canary schedule — Solstice Health

Hi Jamie / Team,

Thanks again for executing the order — congrats and welcome aboard. Attached is the first draft of the post-signature playchart we've embedded into the MAP for SOL-2026-045 (file: SOL-045_MAP_Runbook_v1.pdf). High-level summary below and two asks at the bottom.

Summary (phased rollout embedded in MAP):
- Phase 0 — Prep & Provision (Week 0): infra provisioning (dedicated pool), KMS key onboarding, DNS entries, and cross-account IAM bindings.
- Phase 1 — Staging validation (Week 1): model validation on a shadow dataset, latency/cost baseline collection, smoke tests.
- Phase 2 — Canary wave (Week 2): staggered canary across 3 waves (5% -> 25% -> 100% of targeted flows) with 24–48h observation windows and automated rollback triggers.
- Phase 3 — Migration & traffic cutover (Week 3–4): batch migrations by tenant group; warm caches; KV pre-warm; final cutover after acceptance gates.
- Phase 4 — Training & ops handoff (Week 4): two 90-minute training sessions for ops and dev teams + runbook handoff.

Monitoring & acceptance gates (embedded in MAP):
- Canary metrics: 95th p99 latency, token cost delta, error-rate spike, semantic-eval regressions on the agreed prompt suite.
- Health checks: tracing hooks and per-route circuit breakers; automatic fallback policy to smaller quantized variant if throughput exceeds thresholds.

Attachments included: SOL-045_MAP_Runbook_v1.pdf (contains timeline, contact matrix, rollback SOP).

Two quick asks from our side: please confirm (A) preferred go-live week window (we proposed Week 3 starting 2026-12-14 in the runbook) and (B) primary training owner at Solstice (name + preferred timezone for scheduling).

We’ll coordinate the intake call once you confirm the two items — I’ve tentatively blocked time for a kickoff on 2026-12-08 if that works.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-signature deployment plan & proposed canary schedule — Solstice Health

Thanks Jamie — quick answers and a couple of technical clarifications from the canary/playbook side.

- Audit logs: yes — we can retain inference-level audit logs for 12 months. We will provide a daily S3 export (per-account prefix) and an account manifest. I’ll attach the export sample in v2 of the runbook.
- Canary mechanics (short):
  * Wave 1 (5%): single-region, dedicated pool with prewarmed KV cache; run smoke evals on the agreed prompt set every 6 hours.
  * Wave 2 (25%): expand to 2 regions, enable continuous batching, watch cost-per-token delta and p99 latency.
  * Wave 3 (100%): full traffic only after semantic-eval regression <1.5% and operational SLOs met for 48h.
- Rollback triggers we’ll configure in the MAP: p99 > 1.8x baseline, error-rate > 1.2%, or semantic-eval regression > 1.5% (auto-failover to quantized variant).

I’ve also attached a lean checklist (canary-checklist.xlsx) that our SREs will use for each wave — it includes prewarm commands, Prometheus + tracing queries, and runbook play IDs. Monica — can you lead the training sessions? We recommend two slots: one for Dev (developer-facing API usage + observability hooks) and one for Ops (runbooks, rollback, cost controls).
